title: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: A classic Indian dish featuring marinated chicken in a creamy tomato sauce. Serve with fluffy basmati rice and naan bread.
instructions: 1. In a bowl, whisk together yogurt, garam masala, cumin, cayenne, salt, and black pepper.
2. Add the chicken to the marinade and mix until coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
3. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray.
4. Remove the chicken from the marinade and place on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until cooked through.
5. While the chicken is baking, melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes or until fragrant.
6. Stir in the tomato puree, chicken broth, and heavy cream (if using). Bring to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes or until the sauce has thickened.
7. Remove the chicken from the oven and add to the saucepan with the tomato sauce.
8. Simmer the chicken in the sauce for 5-10 minutes or until the sauce has coated the chicken evenly.
9. Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
10. Serve the chicken in the sauce over fluffy basmati rice and naan bread.
